readout.source_semantics: Public implementation and tracked metric records. Raw, text-free logits are distributed in this archive, outside Git.

candidate.source_semantics: Public implementation and tracked metric records. Raw, text-free logits are distributed in this archive, outside Git.

decision.source_semantics: Public frozen protocol and inference/analysis code. Text-free responses are distributed outside Git; complete.json files identify their hashes.

decision3.source_semantics: Public frozen protocol and evaluation runner. Six released models, full BANKING77 test, calibration, transfer, perturbations, demonstrations and isolated local timings. Text-free predictions remain outside the public Git tree. Each complete.json records its original checksum.

records.source_semantics: Unmodified detailed records from the named public commit, plus the three precision input files whose hashes are recorded in its public summary. Reader reports, aggregate summaries, figures and linked release evidence remain in Git.

additional_input_provenance.scope: Three NF4 seed metrics were absent from the earlier public tree. Their hashes match the sources already recorded in the public precision summary, and restoring them reproduces that summary without changes.
